title: Legal Notice & Terms and Conditions of Sale

editor.title: Site Publisher
editor.text: L’Écrin Français is a brand dedicated to the creation and personalisation of bespoke cases and presentation boxes. The site is published by L’Écrin Français, a company or structure operating under this brand, with its registered office in France.

ip.title: Intellectual Property
ip.text: All content on the site — texts, images, logos, visuals, designs and presentation elements — is the property of L’Écrin Français or its partners and is protected by intellectual property rights. Any unauthorised reproduction or use is prohibited.

data.title: Privacy Policy (GDPR)
data.text: The information collected (name, address, email, phone number) is necessary to process your order and issue invoices. Your data is only shared with our logistics partners for delivery purposes; it is never sold to third parties. You have the right to access, correct and delete your data: to exercise it, contact ecrinfrancais@gmail.com.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions of Sale
terms.text: Quotes and price proposals are given as an indication and may be adjusted according to the final specifications, manufacturing lead time, materials selected and technical complexity of the project. Orders are confirmed after written validation by the client and payment of any deposits due.

customProducts.title: Bespoke and Personalised Products
customProducts.text: Products sold by L’Écrin Français are made to order according to the client's precise specifications (dimensions, wood essences, engravings).

noWithdrawal.title: Absence of Right of Withdrawal
noWithdrawal.text: In accordance with Article L221-28 of the French Consumer Code, the right of withdrawal cannot be exercised for contracts for the supply of goods made to the consumer's specifications or clearly personalised. Consequently, no cancellation, return or refund can be accepted once the order has been validated and manufacturing has begun, except in the event of a proven non-conformity (technical defect or dimension error on our part).

woodTolerance.title: Technical Tolerances (Wood)
woodTolerance.text: As wood is a living material, variations in colour, grain or texture may appear compared to the 3D visuals shown on the site. These natural variations cannot be considered defects and do not justify a refusal of the goods.

delivery.title: Lead Times and Delivery
delivery.text: The announced manufacturing lead time (4 weeks) is given as an indication. A reasonable delay cannot give rise to order cancellation or damages.
